fluff.overview: The Ebon Keshik is a group of elite, black-clad Elementals who guard the most sacred sites on Strana Mechty. Battle armor is too bulky for these human-scale facilities, so these warriors are most commonly equipped as foot infantry in specially sculpted black body armor and armed with Clan-standard Mauser IIC assault systems. Unlikely to see combat, a warrior assigned to the Ebon Keshik has little to look forward to beyond a Trial of Position against a younger warrior and the inevitable relegation to a solahma unit. Patrolling the corridors of power on Strana Mechty is the ultimate achievement in the career of an Elemental, yet it is a tainted honor, marking the end of a warrior's useful service rather than a reward for distinguished performance.
